title: Inbound
description: Every message, order and payment NIVO receives, with its source and whether it is real or simulated.
simAlertBody: Zalo, Facebook, Email and Bank are simulated: they are not connected to the real services yet. Website chat is real (through the Chatbot).
simDesc: Send a test message, order or payment as if it came from a channel. NIVO handles it exactly like a real one.
presetsLabel: Quick examples (they only fill the form)
eventIdHint: The channel's own id for this event. Sending the same ID again is a duplicate; a new ID is a new input, even with the same text.
presetBodyZalo: I need advice on a customer care package
bankNote: Simulated connection: credits reach NIVO through a secured test webhook, not from the bank itself. A credit whose content names exactly one open payment record code with the same amount is matched by itself; anything else waits for your check.
feedDesc: Latest first. An event received again (same event ID) is counted as a duplicate, not processed twice.
feedEmptyBody: Use the form above to send the first input, or start with a quick example.
loadFailBody: The inbound feed is not available yet. Try again in a moment.
